video_title: Is Shai going to INSPIRE a WHOLE generation of hoopers to flop 😭

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's evolution into a player who draws fouls
quotes.excerpt: Shai never always played like this. He just figured it out. Just like every other player did.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I don't understand why James Harden started this a long time ago with the foul baiting. And now it's an issue now with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander doing it. I don't get it. Their team is good, bro. Forget the fouls, forget what he's getting. The man is still a bucket. Yeah, he gets fouled. He's learned how to, you know, people come to his body, he knows how to act. Fine, that's part of the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Shai never always played like this. He just figured it out. Just like every other player did. The one thing that I kind of looked at, you got to look at it from his perspective. If this makes it easier for him, why would you not do that? That doesn't make no sense to me.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: The art of flopping and its role in modern NBA games
quotes.excerpt: Flopping is an art. Flopping is part of the game though.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Flopping is an art. Flopping is part of the game though. Some people do it better than others. I'm sure guys are working on this shit. They are trying to figure out how to do it.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The shit that gets me the mad is like when they do a screen and they barely run into it and their head goes back. You do this shit all the time, bro. That shit get me fucking tight. And the ref falls for it every single time.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Young players are learning to flop from watching NBA stars
quotes.excerpt: Kids are doing it not because of some fucking SGA. Kids are doing it because that's the game now.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Kids are doing it not because of some fucking SGA. Kids are doing it because that's the game now. If you watch AAU, I bet you he ain't going to no goddamn AAU games. I'm coaching in AAU. I see this. These kids are doing that now. That's part of the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: So you're saying that I'm not watching Shai Gilgeous-Alexander do that and taking it to my game? No, they are watching Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. Everybody in NBA is doing it. It ain't just Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver's perspective on the difference between flopping and selling calls
quotes.excerpt: There's a difference between selling a call, exaggeration and a true flop, which is where you're actually fooling the referees.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Adam Silver said this yesterday. How about the flopping? Flopping, flopping, flopping, big conversation, Mr. Commissioner.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Yeah, it's it and it's been a conversation. I would only say that there's a difference between selling a call, exaggeration and a true flop, which is where you're actually fooling the referees. I think sometimes even as I sit in the stands at games, players may be falling down, players may be reacting to a call, but then to me if they're not fooling the referees, it's like okay, that's like the players are taught to sell calls these days.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of AI technology on NBA officiating accuracy
quotes.excerpt: I think technology and sports go hand in hand. It betters the game, makes the game better I think.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Adam Silver says officiating has been incredible. He also said they will have automated calls for your out of bounds and etc.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I mean I like what what baseball integrated with the what do you call that? The strike zone. They tap their head shit. Pause. I think it works. You want to get the right call. I agree with that. So adding AI technology, I think technology and sports go hand in hand. It betters the game, makes the game better I think.
